notes.title: V1.11 Update: New Effects, Bug Fixes, and Improvements
notes.content:
V.1.11

New Features:

 - Added new laser effects to music levels.
 - Introduced gun recoil and shooting effects.

Improvements:

 - Updated dust and bullet trails for guns.
 - Enhanced bonus target visuals with added fog.
 - Refined figure formation, reducing the number of elements.
 - Improved load times for levels.

Bug Fixes:

 - Fixed issues with track names in the end-level UI.
 - Resolved a bug causing infinite level endings.

notes.title: 🎉 Release Day! 🎉
notes.content:
We are excited to announce the release of the first version of Reach The Beat! Now you can dive into this rhythm-driven VR experience and start playing right away. Your journey begins with a world where music and action collide, challenging you to synchronize your moves and showcase your precision with blasters across every level.

As we continue to develop and improve the game, your feedback and suggestions are incredibly valuable to us. We are committed to making Reach The Beat the best experience possible, and your input will help shape future updates. Whether it's new features, tweaks, or additional content, we look forward to bringing your ideas to life in the next versions of the game.

Thank you for joining us on this musical adventure. We can’t wait to hear what you think!
